data.one_liner: Multi‑platform Dart SDK for PocketBase REST API
data.what_it_does: PocketBase Dart SDK lets you interact with the PocketBase backend via REST, including authentication, CRUD, file uploads and realtime subscriptions. It provides a simple, type‑safe API and an AuthStore for token management.
use_when: You need a lightweight backend for CRUD and realtime data in a Flutter or Dart app
You want to use PocketBase as your backend instead of Firebase or Supabase
You need file upload support and realtime subscriptions in a single package
avoid_when: You already use a different backend SDK such as Firebase or Supabase
You require a persistent AuthStore out of the box without custom implementation
strengths: Simple, single‑file SDK with no build_runner dependencies
AuthStore with event stream for auth changes
weaknesses: AuthStore is not persistent by default
No code generation for models (requires manual DTOs)
